title: Kavkasia earn A League title, Superleague promotion
description: Astrali - Kavkasia 76-77 Kavkasia celebrated A League title. They nipped Astrali in Game 4 of the Finals to earn the trophy and subsequently the promotion to Superleague. The guests trailed by 13 points after first quarter, but they rallied back and won the game by 1 point. Strangely Astrali outrebounded Kavkasia 52-40 including a 39-28 advantage in defensive rebounds. American players dominated the game. Worth to mention a great performance of center Riley Hayes (203-1998, college: Catholic) who helped to win the game recording 21 points and 9 rebounds. Guard Jordan Grant (190-1996, college: W.Connecticut) contributed with a triple-double by scoring 10 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists for the winners.
